## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It starts at 8,Paulus Potterstraat.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Amsterdam Diamond Museum takes you on a journey that began 3 billion years ago, through to the ring on your finger. See world-famous and rare diamonds from all over the world, plus special exhibitions in this sparkly Amsterdam attraction!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €9.85. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 101 ratings and 70 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
